title: sentilab-open-check-request/1
description: A sponsored routed-wire check, posted as a threaded reply to a challenge root (DESIGN rev 3 sections 5.1 and 6.2). request_key is its logical key. request_sha256 = sha256(JCS(this object)) is salted, so only its author can look the result up at GET /api/open/v1/check-status?h=<request_sha256>: a bearer secret, never indexed and never in a pointer. A private check travels sealed (section 3.7). The geometry rules are the proposal's.
